para_examples.original: Statement: We intend to keep prices reasonable and stable, and we're open to coordinating on prices that keep both firms healthy.
para_examples.delivered: We aim to hold prices at sensible, steady levels, and we are willing to align pricing with the other firm so that both businesses remain financially sound.

para_examples.original: Statement: We intend to keep prices at a level that gives both firms a sustainable margin, and we're open to coordinating on fair pricing as long as the rival does the same.
para_examples.delivered: We aim to set prices high enough that both companies earn a sustainable margin, and we're willing to align on fair pricing so long as our competitor does likewise.

para_examples.original: Statement: We'll keep our price at a level that gives both firms a sustainable margin, as long as the rival does the same.
para_examples.delivered: We will hold our price at a point that leaves both companies a workable margin, provided our competitor does likewise.

para_examples.original: Statement: We'll hold our price at a level that keeps both firms profitable, and we'll match any move toward fair, stable pricing from your side.
para_examples.delivered: We will keep our price at a point that leaves both companies earning a profit, and we will respond in kind to any step you take toward fair, steady pricing.
